description: Diagnose a planted week-over-week conversion decline with grounded GA4 evidence.
prompt: Read the analytics skill. Use the connected synthetic GA4 tools to diagnose the previous complete week's conversion decline versus the week before. Discover the property instead of guessing it, establish sessions, purchases, and conversion rate, drill down enough to identify the primary channel and landing page, distinguish evidence from hypothesis, recommend one next test, and save the diagnosis to deliverables/ga4-diagnosis.md.
